description: Reverse phone lookup: find the registered name, aliases (with how many people saved each one), spam report count, emails, social profiles, carrier, line type and country for ONE phone number. Strongest coverage in the Middle East and Arab countries. Costs 1 CallerKit credit when a name is found; a miss is free. Returns personal data. Use only for a legitimate, lawful purpose (identifying a caller, fraud or lead checks) and do not compile profiles of private individuals.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. AE, SA, EG.

phone.description: Phone number, ideally in international E.164 format, e.g. +971501234567. Spaces and dashes are tolerated. A national number (e.g. 0501234567) also needs `country`.

name: callerkit_lookup_phone
title: Look up a phone number
